# chaos-tdd-fault-injection

> An Agent Skill (MIT; developed and tested on Claude Code) for chaos-TDD on LLM agent pipelines: build a fault catalog from operational bug history, inject each fault deterministically at existing seams (interface-seam fake + HTTP-layer mock, never a production hook), and let the fault-injection test state the desired guarded behavior first so the minimal guard — usually a reason-coded abstain — ships in the same PR.

## Core documentation

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): self-contained Q&A reference for AI agents (Project Facts, the five disciplines, worked failure shapes)
- [README.md](README.md): human-facing narrative (install, discipline table, origin & curation model)
- [SKILL.md](skills/chaos-tdd-fault-injection/SKILL.md): full skill specification — catalog construction, injection seams with a `ChaosBackend` sketch, determinism discipline, steady-state channels, the TDD contract, and the failure shapes the pattern reliably catches

## Architecture

- 5 disciplines: **catalog from operational history** (mine incidents, diff against test coverage), **existing seams only** (schedule-driven interface fake + request-mock HTTP layer), **determinism** (seeded schedules, derandomized property fuzz with @example pins, latency expressed as injected timeout exceptions, run-twice-identical PASS criterion), **steady state on observable channels** (telemetry outcome/error_kind + greppable reason=<code> tokens), **TDD contract** (the chaos test asserts behavior that does not exist yet; the guard lands in the same PR)
- Rejected altitudes: chaostoolkit/toxiproxy (infrastructure-level chaos between services — a single-process agent injects in-process), production random chaos (irreplaceable stored data, flaky CI)
- First-deployment findings: non-string schema violations via str() promotion, JSON null mis-routed by a None-as-failure sentinel, fault kinds indistinguishable in telemetry
- Curation model: manually curated (no script sync) — generalized publication of the operational variant running inside the Contemplative Agent project (paired decision record: ADR-0077)

## Standard reference

- [Agent Skill specification](https://agentskills.io/specification): the open Agent Skills format used by this repo
- Install: clone the repo and copy `skills/chaos-tdd-fault-injection` into `~/.claude/skills/` (see [README.md](README.md)); other Agent Skills-compatible agents take the same folder in their own skills directory

## Sibling skills

- [when-code-when-llm](https://github.com/shimo4228/when-code-when-llm) (frozen record, no longer developed): task-level structural-vs-semantic tool choice — "which tool for this one property"
- [code-and-llm-collaboration](https://github.com/shimo4228/code-and-llm-collaboration): pipeline-level patterns for layering deterministic code and LLM calls
- [llm-agent-security-principles](https://github.com/shimo4228/llm-agent-security-principles): security-by-absence and defense patterns for LLM agents
- [search-first](https://github.com/shimo4228/search-first): research-before-coding workflow with a 4-way Adopt / Extend / Compose / Build decision
- [skill-comply](https://github.com/shimo4228/skill-comply): measures whether agents actually follow skill / rule definitions
